name: Alpha 78 Logistics Center
location: 5 Edge Road, Alpha, Warren County, NJ: directly off Route 22, adjacent to I-78
summary: A 450,457 SF cross-docked warehouse on a 33.67-acre site, developed by Woodmont Industrial Partners with Brookfield Properties: 36-foot clear, 118 dock doors, four drive-ins, a 130-foot truck court, 89 trailer and 230 car spaces.

sources.title: Woodmont Properties: Properties / Portfolio (Alpha 78 Logistics Center)

Woodmont, Brookfield announce plans to develop industrial site in Warren County
Woodmont, Brookfield detail start of 450,000 sq. ft. industrial project in Warren County

images.caption: Rendering of the Alpha 78 Logistics Center (Real Estate NJ, 2024-08-14)

buildingSf.label: Building area
buildingSf.quote: "450,457 SF" (CBRE); "450,000 SF of warehousing and office space" (Woodmont Properties)

clearHeight.label: Clear height
clearHeight.quote: "a 36-foot clear height, an ESFR sprinkler system, a 130-foot truck court" (Woodmont Properties)

docks.label: Dock doors
docks.quote: "118 DOCK DOORS" (CBRE); "118 dock doors with four drive-ins" (Real Estate NJ)

trailerStalls.label: Trailer parking
trailerStalls.quote: "89 truck/trailer parking spots" (ROI-NJ); "parking for 89 trucks or trailers and 230 cars" (Real Estate NJ)

location.label: Location
location.value: 5 Edge Road, Alpha NJ; off Route 22, adjacent to I-78
location.quote: "5 EDGE ROAD, ALPHA, NJ" (CBRE); "located directly off Route 22 and I-78" (Woodmont Properties)

buildingDepthFt.label: Building depth
buildingDepthFt.estimate: Not published. 400 ft is within the usual 360-420 ft range for a cross-dock building of this size.

buildingLengthFt.label: Building length
buildingLengthFt.estimate: 450,457 SF / the estimated 400 ft depth = 1,126 ft; it moves with the depth estimate.

eaveHeight.label: Wall height above the warehouse floor
eaveHeight.estimate: 41 ft: the published 36 ft clear plus about 5 ft of roof structure.

dockHigh.label: Dock-high floor above the truck courts
dockHigh.estimate: 48 in, the usual dock height; ramps to the drive-in doors are not modelled.

dockSplit.label: Docks and drive-ins per side
dockSplit.value: 59 docks and 2 drive-ins on each long side
dockSplit.estimate: A cross-dock is usually symmetric; the published totals (118 and 4) are split evenly.

dockDoor.label: Dock door size
dockDoor.estimate: Common dock door size; not published.

dockSpacingFt.label: Dock door spacing
dockSpacingFt.estimate: Centre-to-centre; each side's run is centred on its wall.

trailerStall.label: Trailer stall size
trailerStall.estimate: Typical; the 89 stalls are split 45 / 44 in one row past each truck court.

carModule.label: Car parking layout
carModule.value: 9 x 18 ft stalls on 24 ft aisles, split between the two short ends
carModule.estimate: Position and layout are estimates; the count is published.

officeLocation.label: Office position
officeLocation.value: middle of the plan-west end wall, one story
officeLocation.estimate: Not published; drawn as a one-story room about 1.6:1 in plan, in the middle of the west end wall, so both dock walls stay clear.

siteShape.label: Site outline
siteShape.value: rectangle of the published 33.67 acres, the building centred
siteShape.estimate: No parcel geometry or aerial image was reachable from the build environment, so the outline, the building's position on it and its orientation are schematic. The rectangle leaves at least 30 m around the modelled layout (building, courts, trailer rows, car fields); areas and counts are the published ones.

wallThickness.label: Exterior wall thickness
wallThickness.estimate: Tilt-up concrete panels are typically 9-12 in; not published.

notes: ROI-NJ and Real Estate NJ (August 2024, at announcement) gave 6,000 SF of office; the current CBRE leasing site lists a 3,000 SF spec office. The leasing site is used.
ROI-NJ said completion was expected in the third quarter of 2025; Woodmont's site says the building "is available for immediate occupancy."
Woodmont's site rounds the building to 450,000 SF; CBRE gives 450,457 SF, which is used.
